name: x64dbg
description_en: An open-source user mode debugger for Windows. Optimized for reverse engineering and malware analysis.
readme_excerpt: x64dbg An open-source binary debugger for Windows, aimed at malware analysis and reverse engineering of executables you do not have the source code for. There are many features available and a comprehensive plugin system to add your own. You can find more information on the blog! Screenshots | :--: | :--: | Installation & Usage 1.
